objective: Prove the explicit degree-3 Sherali-Adams refutation from the corner identity (sum over lines of monochromatic indicators minus sum over faces = 1), note that its coefficients are unary (so the count is in PPADS by Goos et al.), and measure how a cutting-planes solver (Exact) and an XOR-reasoning solver (CryptoMiniSat with Gaussian elimination) scale on the knot spheres against plain CDCL.
status: Proved (COUNT-NOTE-20261107-001B-P001): the sphere's count has a unary Sherali-Adams refutation of degree 3. Sum over lines of the two clause falsifiers minus sum over the n - 4 three-point faces of two complementary conjunctions equals 1 (4n - 8 terms, coefficients +-1; checked on K_2..K_8), so finding a violated line is in PPADS^dt (Goos et al.), between one-sided 2D Sperner and PPADS. Experiment: cutting-planes (Exact) and XOR-reasoning (CryptoMiniSat) solvers do no better than CDCL on K_2..K_7.
title: The count among proof systems
